title: AgentArmy Canonical Ontology IR
description: The single source-of-truth intermediate representation for the ontology-derived generative pipeline. Authored in OntoUML/UFO stereotypes; compiled into many projections (gUFO OWL, BFO/CCO, SHACL, C#, ArcadeDB, PROV-O). This schema is validation Level 1 (syntactic): well-formed model, unique IDs, valid stereotypes. See README.md.

types.description: Object/aspect/event types, each carrying an OntoUML stereotype.

relators.description: N-ary relationships reified as first-class relators with typed roles (hyperedge-as-vertex). A binary relation is a degenerate 2-role relator.

relations.description: Non-reified relations: «material» (derived from a relator), «formal», parthood, «mediation», «characterization».

processes.description: Perdurants (UFO «event»/«situation») that transform endurants over time — the model's process-awareness. Each compiles to a BPMN/CACAO projection (ARC-ADR-031 Q5) executed by the runbook-orchestrator kernel inside the DBOS durable runtime (ARC-ADR-038).

constraints.description: Validation constraints targeting types/relators, expressed for a downstream prover (SHACL/Alloy/SMT/OWL).

stereotype.description: OntoUML class stereotype. See ufo-ontology skill ONTOUML_PROFILE.md.

imports.description: Pinned upstream vocabularies (gUFO, SEON, gist, FIBO, OWL-Time, PROV-O, SOSA, DCAT, BFO, CCO...).

provenance.description: Per-element provenance (PROV-O). Drives the provenance projection + bitemporal stamping.

source.description: Where this element came from (SME, doc, source model id).

range.description: Datatype or type id (e.g. string, integer, SeverityLevel).

parent.description: id of the supertype this specializes (subkind/phase/role inherit a kind's identity).

gufo_type.description: gUFO type class for the OWL projection, e.g. gufo:Kind.

bfo_class.description: BFO/CCO target for the realist projection, e.g. obo:BFO_0000030 or cco:Person. Best-effort; record divergences in docs/mapping-rules.md.

participant_type.description: id of a type that fills this role.

roles.description: Typed role bindings. Keep role types disjoint (avoid the RelOver anti-pattern).

temporal.description: Bitemporal validity carried ON the relator (valid time + transaction time).

bfo_pattern.description: How this relator projects to BFO (it has no single counterpart). See bfo-ontology skill.

derived_from.description: For «material» relations: the relator id this is derived from.

process.description: A perdurant: a process/event that acts on endurants over time. Compiles to BPMN 2.0 / CACAO 2.0 (ARC-ADR-031). Process instances are pinned as bitemporal perdurant records (RT5).

trigger.description: What starts the process. Maps to a BPMN start event / CACAO step_extensions.trigger; binds to a fleet.* CloudEvent subject (ARC-ADR-022) or a durable cron (ARC-ADR-018/-038).

schedule.description: Cron expression for kind=timer — emitted as a DBOS scheduled (durable) workflow.

transforms.description: ids of the endurant types this process acts on — the link that makes the object model process-aware.

steps.description: Ordered activities run by the kernel.

temporal.description: Bitemporal validity of the process instance (pinned as a perdurant, RT5).

kind.description: service→invoke the Agent Gateway (ARC-ADR-028); call→nest a sub-process (DBOS child workflow); wait→durable timer/catch (DBOS sleep/recv); decision→gateway branch; parallel→fan-out; manual→HITL ack (ARC-ADR-006); emit-event→publish a CloudEvent; end→terminal.

agent.description: For kind=service: Agent Gateway agent slug (POST /a2a/v1/agents/{slug}/tasks).

calls.description: For kind=call: id of the sub-process to nest (recursive).

subject.description: For kind=wait/emit-event: the fleet.* CloudEvent subject.

timeout.description: For kind=wait: ISO-8601 duration; a durable DBOS sleep that survives restart.

condition.description: For decision branches: a FEEL/STIX-subset expression (ARC-ADR-031 Q4).

target.description: id of the type/relator the constraint applies to.

expression.description: Human-readable rule; the generator emits the language-specific form.

projections.description: Which projections the generator emits from this IR. Each is a separate representation — never collapse them.

bfo_cco.description: BFO 2020 + CCO realist sidecar — interop projection.

bpmn.description: BPMN 2.0 XML process projection from `processes` — run by the runbook-orchestrator kernel (ARC-ADR-031/-038).

cacao.description: OASIS CACAO 2.0 JSON playbook projection from `processes` (ARC-ADR-031/-038).

dlt_anchor.description: Anchor only hashes/manifests, never the graph.
